name: Fluid Dynamics
source:
Rin is back from Sydney for the National Team Trials at the annual Japan Swim tournament, and he's staying with Haruka for a few days until he can find a place of his own to live. This gives Haruka a narrow window to summon up the courage to ask Rin to stay with him on a more permanent basis...as something more than friends.

[From [url=http://saso2015-r2.dreamwidth.org/6137.html]official site[/url]]
